input.command:
cd /tmp/zc-runs/c9827cfc203d; S=.tmp/claude-0/-tmp-zc-runs-c9827cfc203d/a5c89a26-d051-4515-9f4e-fff534d036e3/scratchpad; mkdir -p $S; cat > $S/ext.py <<'EOF'
import pdfplumber,sys,os
out=sys.argv[2]
for f in os.listdir(sys.argv[1]):
    if not f.endswith('.pdf'): continue
    with pdfplumber.open(os.path.join(sys.argv[1],f)) as p:
        with open(os.path.join(out,f+'.txt'),'w') as o:
            for i,pg in enumerate(p.pages):
                t=pg.extract_text() or ''
                o.write(f"\n=== PAGE {i+1} size={pg.width:.0f}x{pg.height:.0f} chars={len(t)}\n{t}\n")
EOF
python -I $S/ext.py package $S; ls -la $S; grep -c "" $S/*.txt
